name: chesthq-packages
description: Public npm packages for Chest Gate — sdk, proxy, cli, mcp, install, upstream-proxy.

scripts.release:sdk: npm run build --workspace=sdk && npm publish --workspace=sdk --access public
scripts.release:proxy: npm run build --workspace=proxy && npm publish --workspace=proxy --access public
scripts.release:cli: npm run build --workspace=cli && npm publish --workspace=cli --access public
scripts.release:mcp: npm run build --workspace=mcp && npm publish --workspace=mcp --access public
scripts.release:install: npm run build --workspace=install && npm publish --workspace=install --access public
scripts.release:upstream-proxy: npm run build --workspace=upstream-proxy && npm publish --workspace=upstream-proxy --access public
